Mapping page: exposed interfaces at 03f2168
|
|-- MCP tools (also callable through HTTP)                                          -> backend
|   |
|   |-- Discovery / reading
|   |   |-- diagram-search                 Search or read diagrams                  -> backend
|   |   `-- canvas-api-search              Discover methods and schemas
|   |
|   |-- Canvas editing                                                              -> backend
|   |   |-- draw_diagram                   Create/replace from finished ASCII
|   |   |-- set_diagram_source_mappings    Replace mappings and evidence
|   |   |-- save_diagram                   Publish a live document/diagram          -> backend
|   |   `-- exec                           Each mutation commits separately         -> backend
|   |       |
|   |       |-- canvas
|   |       |   |-- list
|   |       |   |-- attach
|   |       |   |-- createDocument
|   |       |   `-- copyDocument                Independent unsaved draft
|   |       |
|   |       |-- nodes
|   |       |   |-- list / get
|   |       |   |-- draw / replace / patchDiagram
|   |       |   |-- move / collapse / remove
|   |       |   `-- setJumps / setSourceMappings
|   |       |
|   |       `-- edges
|   |           `-- list / create / update / remove
|   |
|   |-- Prompt-driven diagram editing                                               -> backend
|   |   |-- edit-diagram                   Start generation/application run         -> backend
|   |   |-- edit-diagram-status            Inspect run progress/result
|   |   `-- cancel-diagram-edit            Cancel before application
|   |
|   `-- Change proposals
|       |-- create_diagram_change_session  Capture isolated proposal copies         -> backend
|       |-- update_diagram_change_session Annotate, ready/archive, undo/redo/reset  -> backend
|       `-- accept_diagram_change_session Publish the ready proposal atomically     -> backend
|
|-- HTTP routes: /api/mapping
|   |
|   |-- Agent tool transport
|   |   `-- POST   /agent/tools/{toolName}  All twelve MCP tools above
|   |
|   |-- Live browser canvas bridge                                                  -> backend
|   |   |-- GET    /agent/canvases          List registered workspaces
|   |   |-- POST   /agent/canvases          Register/refresh browser workspace
|   |   |-- DELETE /agent/canvases/{id}     Unregister workspace
|   |   |-- GET    /agent/canvases/{id}/commands
|   |   |                                  Browser polls for commands
|   |   `-- POST   /agent/canvases/{id}/reply
|   |                                      Browser returns command results
|   |
|   |-- Live selection reader                                                       -> backend
|   |   `-- GET /live/connections/{id}/selection
|   |       `-- Current selection mirror for an attached reader
|   |
|   |-- Changes tab
|   |   |-- GET /agent/change-sessions                  List summaries
|   |   |-- GET /agent/change-sessions/{id}             Full session
|   |   `-- GET /agent/change-sessions/{id}/preview
|   |           ?documentId=...&version=...             Selected canvas preview
|   |
|   |-- Workspace persistence                                                       -> backend
|   |   |-- GET  /workspace/records         Load incremental records
|   |   |-- POST /workspace/records         Apply atomic record batch
|   |   |-- GET  /workspace                 Load reconstructed snapshot
|   |   `-- PUT  /workspace                 Save complete snapshot (compatibility)
|   |
|   |-- Saved diagrams
|   |   |-- POST   /diagrams                Save a representation
|   |   `-- DELETE /diagrams/{id}           Delete a representation
|   |
|   `-- Existing agent-backed operations                                            -> backend
|       |-- POST /prompt                   Selection-based diagram generation/patch
|       |-- POST /chat                     Local chat
|       |-- POST /compactions              Run file compaction
|       `-- GET  /compactions/{id}          Read saved compaction run
|           (POST operations stream progress/results)
|
|-- Live WebSocket transport                                                        -> backend
|   |-- Browser publication / reader attachment
|   |-- Selection snapshots / deltas
|   |-- context.get
|   `-- agent-context.upload                                                        -> backend
|
`-- Shared HTTP routes: /api/core/project
    |-- GET  /representations              Project and representation catalog
    |-- GET  /files                        Browse repository directory
    |-- GET  /source                       Read repository file
    |-- POST /definitions                  Resolve source definitions
    |-- POST /projections                  Create representation projection
    |-- GET  /corpus-compactions           List corpus compactions
    `-- POST /corpus-compactions           Create corpus compaction
